cautions: Treat this as a dated point-in-time dataset. Do not call it live data.
Do not confuse market-wide citation ranges with the site's actual citations.
A grounding query is not necessarily an exact user-entered search query.
Do not claim which article URL received a citation without page-level citation evidence.
Bing topic categorization may be incorrect; do not mechanically edit unrelated topics.
English-language query opportunities do not by themselves prove Japanese search demand.
Compare like-for-like observation windows before claiming growth or effects of revisions.
Use primary manufacturer evidence for technical accuracy and current Google/Bing performance for traffic decisions.
